newsitem.title: USA: Northwest close to Airbus order - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Northwest close to Airbus order - WSJ.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp is close to a deal to order 50 Airbus Industrie jetliners with a list-price value of $2 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said Northwest is in the later stage of negotiations to order 50 narrow-body, 125-seat A-319s, with options on up to 100 more of the jets.
If all options were exercised, the Northwest order would have a list price of about $6 billion.
The first 50 Airbus jetliners would be introduced to Northwest's fleet in 1999 as replacements for some of its older Boeing 727s and McDonnell Douglas Corp DC-9s, sources told the Journal.
